purpose: Resolve verification evidence generated after the final implementation commit without embedding a self-referential commit hash.
resolve_revision: Exact clean Git HEAD supplied by Forge git_status.
validation: commit_sha and review_commit_sha must equal the submitted clean HEAD
base_sha must equal the submitted commit parent
file_checksums must match pinned committed bytes
check artifact_sha256 against the separately supplied checksum
statuses and limitations are taken from executed governed checks
publication: Generated artifacts remain outside the implementation commit. This tracked file is a locator, not a verification result.
